cli_commands.description: Generate shell completion script (bash, zsh, fish, elvish, powershell)
Print OS, kernel, CPU, memory, and uptime (alias for postlab system info)
List all installed packages (alias for postlab packages list)
System diagnostics: info, cpu, mem, disks, net, sensors, load, boot, swap (status/create/delete/enable/disable/resize); [planned] gpu, hardware inventory
Package management: list, search, install, remove, upgrade, cache-clean, list-upgradable
Process management: list (sortable by cpu/mem/pid/name), kill (with --force for SIGKILL)
Systemd service management: list, start, stop, restart, enable, disable
Storage diagnostics: list filesystems (device, mount, size, usage, fs type) and physical disks with SMART health
